content:
In addition to macOS 26.6, Apple has simultaneously released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, providing important bug fixes. Details are as follows.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 Officially Released

After as many as seven Release Candidates, Apple has finally officially released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

The version numbers of the official releases are identical to last week's Release Candidates:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

Apple's release notes merely state that these two updates provide "important security fixes" and recommend that all users still on macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia install them.

In recent weeks, Apple has rolled out multiple security fixes for older system versions, many of which patch WebKit vulnerabilities that could lead to user data leakage. Therefore, if you are still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia, it is recommended that you install these updates as soon as possible.

Update: Apple has published the full security content for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, detailing a combined total of over 138 different vulnerabilities across the two systems.

Are you still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia? Feel free to leave a comment and let us know.
